title: PrecisionProfileQA: Composite task metrics adapter for FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Diego Morales
description: Build a reusable 'PrecisionProfileQA' adapter that composes multiple task-specific metrics into a single validation artifact for FP8/INT8 calibration and rollout gating. The adapter should compute language-model perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy/aggregate accuracy on closed-book QA suites, BLEU/ROUGE for summarization/translation tasks, and pluggable task scorers (classification F1, QA EM, token-level accuracy). Key features: 1) flexible aggregation strategies (per-task weights, task-group normalizations, percentile-based thresholds), 2) permutation-resilient matching for non-deterministic outputs (e.g., list answers, unordered slot fills), 3) uncertainty-aware confidence intervals (bootstrap) for small evaluation splits, and 4) schema'd metric output suitable for the calibration pipeline, gating rules, and Console dashboards. The adapter must integrate with the existing calibration runner and evaluation datasets, emit a standardized JSON metrics contract, and surface regressions as numerical deltas and task-level example buckets for SRE/ML review. This ticket focuses on the implementation, tests, dashboard wiring, and a canary rollout plan for runtime-1.24.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter produces a single JSON per run following the metric contract: top-level fields (profile_id, model_variant, quant_profile, timestamp, dataset, overall_score, task_breakdown) and task entries with name, metric_type, value, confidence_interval
Perplexity calculation for LM tasks matches the reference implementation (difference <= 1%) on the 'lm-xs' eval split
MMLU-style accuracy and macro-average reproduce baseline numbers for the control (float32) run within noise bounds, and report deltas for FP8/INT8 variants
BLEU/ROUGE implementations use the consolidated tokenization pipeline and match the reference scorer for baseline runs
Permutation-resilient matcher de-duplicates and scores unordered list answers (example-based tests included)
Adapter exposes parameterized aggregation (per-task weights and percentile trimming) configurable by calibration job
Integration tests added to the calibration CI job that run a float32 baseline and at least two quantized profiles and assert gates: overall_score >= threshold OR identify task-level regressions
Console dashboard shows the overall_score trend, task breakdown bars, and a link to example buckets for failing tasks
Documentation (Confluence) and a small runbook for interpreting composite scores are published
tasks: Design JSON metric contract and example payloads (link in artifacts)
Implement core adapter: metric registry, tokenizers, and scoring primitives (perplexity, accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE, F1, EM)
Implement permutation-resilient matching utility and unit tests
Add bootstrap confidence-interval wrapper and tests for small-split scenarios
Wire adapter into calibration runner: add CLI flags and config mappings
Create integration test job in CI and calibration pipeline
Add Console wiring: dataprovider endpoint and dashboard panels
Write Confluence doc: usage, thresholds, and interpretation guide
Code review, address feedback, and merge
Canary rollout to runtime-1.24 with 2 models and 3 quant profiles (monitor for regressions)
